newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end sharply higher.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates ended sharply higher on tight market liquidity despite recent fund injection by the central bank, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate finished at 7.898 percent against Thursday's 7.206 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 7.50-8.00 percent against 7.25-7.50.
The rates were expected to stablise around the current level on Saturday, dealers said.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.0800-0925.
